content: Kiki wabim ditarda ia waiakai wa umelebai able ididira mir ge Babidoge tikereder nade ge digrarti. Kiki tasorda a kiki dasmerda kerbi poniu. Kiki sikak dasmerda a kiki itutirda kerbi tagu.
Nade able idid tabakiamuda gem baida kiki abi dasmerda. Kiki able le uridli geki urder, kipe wabi peki detagreda able niai idid ge dawer Babidoge okakise a merbim batomerda.
Kiki wabi koki detagerda nalu kiki dasmerda a tasorda, ia waiakai wako umele kerbidoge batabemeret netat buaise Babidoge a abi Weremge, Iesu Keriso.
Kiki wabim able mir digrareta waiakai wa gair sikak sererge baprekrare.
Able mir kiki tasorda abialam a kipe wabi peki barkak detagreda: Agud bi dali, nole kupkupi abi doge ike.
Ki besle ki umerkak sikak warder ese kiki detautlare mimi netatbuai Agudi doge mi no kupkupige warder.
Mimi no netat buai uridli nade mi bige uridli. Epe able mam ge agimuda abi wermira Iesura gair wit waitkir ese mi bige warder.
Ki kerbibu besbardeda a nole lakak able agekar obarpei nade ki detauteda kiki witkak uridli.
Nade ki keriba wit detauteda Agudim, e tabara mir odikepwarer e ia meriba wit odimaidered. E umele able waiker, e meriba gair adud tonar merbialam adem waitkir.
Mi Agudi dabgereda besle a mi abra mir diweda ese mi detauteda mimi nole witkak.
